{{Quote|Armor Commander.''"<br />"''Are the juggernauts ready?''"<br />"''They are.''"<br />"''Deploy juggernauts.|The Armor Commander and Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
A [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] served the [[Empire of the Hand]] as an '''Armor Commander'''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="CrisisD">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> during a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] between the Empire of the Hand and the forces of the [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]], the [[Armor Commander]] deployed nine [[Tank/Legends|juggernaut]] [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] under Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] directive. Ultimately, the battle ended with Esva's defeat. The non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] had a flat alien voice.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Armor Commander's voice appeared in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
